searchText: Aha, I only looked at the GeneralStateTests until now because that's what Besu's evmtool supports. The problem with that was that our EVM doesn't implement the tries, so we can't use the post state hash. I see now the post state in the BlockchainTests, that's great. Besu also supports retesteth via rpc yes, but to use the RPC we would need to be well integrated with Besu before starting to test the EVM itself. Too complicated. Is there a more up-to-date retesteth Docker image? The website has 0.2.0 but looks like there should be a 0.2.2 or something. Asking because I'm following the "Retesteth in a Docker Container" tutorial, and it fails to run the stExample. It starts with `WARNING: Test was filled with newer version of retesteth! (test: `22` vs retesteth: `20`) This might cause failures, please update retesteth! ` and then `Error: Unexpected field 'solidity' in config: Info _info` I tried rebuilding the Docker image myself, and it fails in a strange way... `retesteth/CMakeFiles/retesteth.dir/build.make:134: recipe for target 'retesteth/CMakeFiles/retesteth.dir/TestHelper.cpp.o' failed c++: internal compiler error: Killed (program cc1plus) Please submit a full bug report, with preprocessed source if appropriate. See <file:///usr/share/doc/gcc-7/README.Bugs> for instructions. make[2]: *** [retesteth/CMakeFiles/retesteth.dir/TestHelper.cpp.o] Error 4 make[2]: *** Waiting for unfinished jobs....` For now I checked out the tests commit tagged 10.2, and that runs as the tutorial expects.
